rows.en:
But she wasn't in the classroom, and it didn't look like she'd gone back to PE either.
I was wandering up and down the hallway, wondering what to do.
Then I heard a sound coming from the chemistry lab.

There was Sanae.
Sanae took a bottle full of some kind of powder off the shelf...
She stuck her middle finger into the bottle, stirred it around a little, and licked the powder off her finger.
While I was still wondering what that was, Sanae staggered out of the chemistry lab and went off somewhere.
What kind of chemical was that...?
The chemical shelves are full of dangerous stuff, you know?{p}

I think there was an idol with that name... And fans carve letters into their desks and stuff, right?
'Ketsu Forever.'
Like that.
People always say that if you sleep with a photo of someone you like, or a paper with their name on it, under your pillow, you'll dream about them.
It's a good thing I was the one who found it...
If a teacher found out she was skipping class to do that, she'd be in big trouble.
Whew, that was scary.
My heart was really pounding.
But you know...
I thought, so even Sanae falls for idols.
She's a girl after all...
Come to think of it, the kids in class had been gossiping about a concert yesterday...
Our school bans gigs and concerts, so everybody has no choice but to go in secret.
Maybe Sanae was one of them?{p}

...Once I started thinking like that, I decided Sanae looking pale was just from lack of sleep.
"I'm tired because I went to a concert."
...She couldn't exactly tell a teacher that, right?
So that's Sanae's secret.
...Just kidding.
Ahaha, did I get you?
No, it's true that Sanae's an idol fan, but the secret is still to come.
I treated my jammed finger myself and went looking for Sanae.
I wasn't all that worried, but she's my friend, after all.{p}Where do you think she was?
The classroom
The roof
The night-duty room

Sanae was in the night-duty room.
...I only noticed because the sound of a TV was leaking out into the hallway...
Inside the night-duty room, Sanae was staring hard at the TV.
Smiling a little...
While I stood frozen there, Sanae slowly murmured.
"They say Ketsu's dead..."
"What!★"
Sanae kept her eyes fixed on the TV.
When I looked at the TV, a daytime talk show was on.{p}

And the caption said,
"Male Idol Vanishes: Mystery Disappearance★"
That's what it said.
Apparently, an idol had vanished from the stage at yesterday's concert.
Right in front of a huge crowd, he faded away like smoke and was gone, they said.
...I realized right away that it was about Ketsu, but...{p}

"Everyone's looking for Ketsu.
Some people even say Ketsu was already dead, and what showed up at the concert was his ghost...
Even though Ketsu is alive and well."
Saying that, Sanae looked at me and laughed.
And in her mouth...☆{p}

I saw human faces.
Tiny human faces, all crammed together.
And among them was a face I'd seen somewhere before...
The same face that was on the TV screen...
"From now on, Ketsu will go on living inside me forever.
He isn't everyone's Ketsu anymore. He's become my Ketsu, and only mine.
It's all thanks to Grandma's charm."{p}

That's when it hit me.
That paper!
That paper was a charm to make the person you love your own.
I bet the people in Sanae's mouth were all taken in the same way.
Which means they're all people she loves.
What do I do? Sooner or later I might get taken in too...
Because Sanae went and said,
"Reiko, let's always be good friends.
Because I love you, Reiko..."
She said that to me.
You'd better be careful too, {c}{f:|}.
I've heard Sanae say your name.
As for what she said...
Ask Sanae.
Well then, that's the end of my story.
Next person, go ahead.{p}

I licked it.
Sanae had licked it too, and it's not like she collapsed or anything.
I figured licking it wouldn't kill me.
And then...
It turned out to be cocoa powder.

The moment I opened the bottle, I smelled sweet cocoa.
Ahaha, it was tasty.
I bet Sanae hides cocoa in the chemistry lab, boils water behind the teachers' backs, and drinks it out of a beaker or something all the time.
Honestly...
She's a strange girl.
Well, that's what makes her fun.
And then I thought,
she was sick and tired, so she wanted something sweet and came to lick some cocoa.
So I decided to go to the nurse's office one more time.
Because Sanae had looked so pale.
Now that I think about it, I'd completely forgotten about the word 'Ketsu' by then.
The question of why Sanae put that scrap of paper in the pillowcase had gone right out of my head.{p}

...When I got to the nurse's office, Sanae was lying in bed.
"Sanae."
When I called her name...

The bed moved, creak, creak.
It was like the bed was answering me.{p}

"S-Sanae."
The bed creaked again.
Even harder this time.
"Sana...!"{p}

Sanae suddenly sprang up!
At the same time, the bed went creeeak, and I screamed with all my might.
"Eeeeeek!☆"
And then Sanae said this.
"Reiko, calm down!
This little one isn't bad."
This little one?
Who's "this little one"?
I was so confused, I threw whatever I could get my hands on at the creaking bed, the nurse's logbook, handouts, anything.
Not that throwing stuff like that would do any good.
"Reiko, this bed is alive.
But it's not a bad one.
I did a blood ritual and breathed a soul into it."
Blood?
A blood ritual?
Sanae, what are you talking about...?{p}

"You see, I wasn't feeling well today, so I was lying down here, and the bed spoke to me.
Um, well, it didn't really speak to me...
I felt it.
I felt that the bed wanted to be alive and move.
So I thought about how I could breathe life into the bed.
And I figured it out.
You put a paper with 'Ketsu' written on it inside the bed.
'Ketsu' means 'blood.'
You can read the character for 'blood' as 'ketsu,' right?
I don't know why I thought that would work, but I really did feel it."
When Sanae started saying stuff like that, I got kind of scared...
I mean, isn't that weird?
Sanae's the kind of girl who bursts into tears at the sight of blood.
So why would she go along with such a creepy request?
She even wrote out the word 'Ketsu.'
She can't stand seeing blood, but a 'blood ritual' is fine?
And besides, why would a bed talk to her?
Why would it ask Sanae to breathe life into it?
Well, it didn't ask... it made her feel it, right?
Sure, Sanae does seem to have a strong sixth sense, but still.{p}

"Reiko, this bed says it wanted life so it could help sick people sleep comfortably.
It wants to wrap them up warm in winter, and shift the covers around in summer to keep them cool...
That's what it's thinking.
So I helped it.
See? It's not a bad one, this bed."
When the bed heard what Sanae said, it creaked happily, creak, creak.
But something's off.
Why would a bed want to devote itself to people?
While I was thinking about that, the finger I'd jammed started to hurt.
But this was no time to be treating it...{p}

While I stood there saying nothing, Sanae lay back down on the bed.
And then the bed creaked even more happily.{p}What would you do at a time like that?
Wake Sanae up
Walk away

I decided to take the bottle to a teacher.
I mean, I had no idea what chemical it was.
If it was something bad, I thought that would be a problem.
So I went to the nurse's office.

The chemistry teacher would have been better, really, but it was during class.
The chemistry teacher was off teaching in some classroom, so I went to tell the school nurse instead.{p}

When I got to the nurse's office, the nurse still wasn't back.
But Sanae was lying in bed.
She must have come straight here from the chemistry lab.
"Huh, Reiko?"
When she saw me, Sanae called out happily, still lying down.
"Oh...!
Reiko, why have you got that bottle?"
Oops☆
I'd walked right up to Sanae still holding the bottle...
I panicked and tried as hard as I could to cover it up.
"Oh, this?
Sanae, you left something behind in the chemistry lab, didn't you?
I saw you a while ago...
Oh, no, that's not it.
I wasn't spying on you, I, um, yeah, I just happened to see you...!"
.........
Then Sanae, totally unbothered, said this.
"Ahaha, you caught me.
That's cocoa, actually.
You can have some too next time, Reiko.
Hide it in the chemistry lab again for me, okay?"
.........{p}

What was I even doing, right?
It seems Sanae was feeling sick and tired, so she wanted something sweet and went to lick some cocoa.
Relieved, I went up close to Sanae, and...

The bed moved, creak, creak.
Sanae wasn't moving at all, but the bed was creaking and rocking.{p}
I thought there really was something wrong with that bed, so I decided to wake Sanae up.
Then the bed didn't like that, and it shook and made a horrible noise.

Then came what I guess you'd call spirit rapping. A horrible noise echoed through the nurse's office, on top of the creaking of the bed!
Even Sanae got scared, and she burst into tears...

"Sanae!
Take the paper out of the pillow!
No, Sanae, not a bed like that!
Don't let it fool you!
If you keep this up, the bed's going to eat you!"
...Maybe I went a little too far.
The bed got angry and shook, banging so hard it seemed like it would go right through the floor...{p}

And then it went quiet.
Sanae had taken out the blood ritual paper.
After that the nurse came back and treated my jammed finger.
Mm, all's well that ends well.
...That's what you think, right?{p}

That 'Ketsu' paper... it'd be bad if Sanae tried to use it again, so I'm the one keeping it.
I'd really like to throw it away, but I'm scared I'd get cursed for it.
And when I tried putting it in my desk, the desk started rattling, or so it seemed.
It looks like it has the power to breathe life into all kinds of things, not just beds.
So I can't just leave that paper lying around.
That's why I always carry it with me.
That blood ritual paper.
I keep it in my skirt pocket, but sometimes I feel like even this skirt is squirming.
Hold on, I'll show it to you.
...Huh? It's not here?
That's weird... I know I put it in my pocket.
It must have been there until I came into this room.{p}Hey, {c}{f:|}, will you help me look for it?
Let's look for it
Let's not
For the moment, {f:I|I} started to get up from my seat.

"So, what did you think of Sanae's story?
Amazing, right? She goes and does some ritual nobody can make sense of.
And on top of that, even you played along, {c}{f:|}."
No, I didn't mean to... Well, never mind.
"Okay, that's the end of my story. Whose turn is next?"{p}

Sanae came back to the classroom for the next period.
She looked full of energy.
Maybe that whole thing about the bed was true.
But...
The bed might be a good one to Sanae, but...
What would the bed do if someone it didn't like came along?
When you lie down in the nurse's office, it's because you're sick, so if the bed was in a bad mood and attacked you, you couldn't fight back, right?
Seriously, you've got to be careful.
What a pain, huh? You can't even let your guard down in bed.
Come to this school, and neither your mind nor your body ever gets any rest.{p}

Well?
Sanae's an interesting girl, isn't she?
But somehow she does scary things like it's nothing.
Everyone, be careful when you lie down in the nurse's office.
...That's the end of my story.
Whose turn is next, I wonder?{p}

Sanae looked really sick, so I decided to go get the nurse.
But the nurse wasn't around.
I thought maybe the nurse was in the restroom, but no.
Then I had no idea where else to look.
I did wander around the nearby hallways for a bit, at least.
But I figured there was no point in doing that.
So I decided to go back to the nurse's office and wait there.{p}

When I got back, Sanae was still shaking and shivering.
I thought I couldn't just leave her like that, so I went over to her.{p}

"Sh... Shanae!"
I was so flustered I couldn't even say Sanae's name properly.
And I'd shouted a lot louder than I meant to...
Ectoplasm is connected to the human medium by a thin, thread-like strand, right? And that thin part...
snapped☆{p}

It must have been something really delicate.
The moment the thread snapped, the ectoplasm vanished, and Sanae never woke up again after that.
Even the doctors say they don't know why...
...But this is my fault, isn't it?
I do feel bad about what I did.
Sanae understood everything and forgave me, but still...{p}
Oh, {c}{f:|}, you're making a funny face!{p}You don't get how Sanae could forgive me when she's still asleep, right?
I can figure that much out
I have no idea at all

Thought so, you don't get it.
Sanae stopped being human!
That doesn't mean she died, though.
...Hmm, I guess you'd call her a monster.
She turned into a rokurokubi!
I didn't know either, but apparently rokurokubi are monsters born from ectoplasm...
It's true.
The ectoplasm I thought had vanished back then didn't vanish. It merged with Sanae.
So now Sanae's a rokurokubi, and while her body sleeps, she stretches her neck out, long and longer, and goes all kinds of places, apparently.
She even came over to visit me.
Though only people with a sixth sense can see her, I hear...
You seem to have a sixth sense, {c}{f:|}, so you might be able to see the rokurokubi...
Try sleeping with your window curtains open tonight.
...That's the end of my story.
Whose turn is next?{p}

I have to run!
That's the first thing I thought...
And I ran away.
Sanae didn't come after me.
But that ectoplasm came after me...
It overtook me and went off somewhere.
It had been a long time since I'd slipped out of PE, so the bell rang for the end of class.
I went straight back to the classroom, and...{p}

The ectoplasm was sitting in my chair.
When I tried to run away again, it wrapped itself around my neck...
It was agony. I couldn't breathe.
I still tried to get away, and just as I managed to take a step...
the ectoplasm went into my eyes.{p}

Ever since then, the ectoplasm has never come back out of my eyes.
So sometimes my eyes hurt really badly.
Well, it only hurts, that's all.
Even now, a little...
Oh, sorry.
...Do you know this?
They say there are two types of spirits.
One is the 'let them go' type.
If someone sees it and runs away, it just leaves them alone.
The other type chases you harder the more you run.
Sanae's ectoplasm was the type of spirit that chases you...
If you ever meet a spirit like that, you mustn't run.
Got it?
Don't run.
Right now, the ectoplasm from the story I just told is inside my body...
Even if it comes out of my eyes, don't you dare run.
If you run... don't blame me.
Though it would suit me better if you did run.
...That's the end of my story.
Whose turn is next?{p}

"I-I didn't see anything."
I answered nervously.
Then Sanae made a really scary face and said,
"Then why are you so scared?"
...I'd made her angry.
I thought I couldn't keep lying, so this time I answered honestly.
"I'm sorry.
The truth is, I saw it.
What... was that?
Sanae, did you know about it yourself?"{p}

Really?
You'd believe a story like this right away...
Huh?
You want to meet Sanae?
{c}{f:|}, {f:are you trying to hit on her|do you mean it}?
Oh well, I'll tell Sanae.
{f:Oh, come on|Next time}, {f:you don't have to make excuses|come over to our class}.
{f:I hope you two end up going out|I'll introduce you}.
Sanae's a little odd, but she's a good girl.
{f:But|Oh}, {f:when you kiss her|I know}, {f:your mouth might feel all squirmy|let's all have lunch together then}.
Hee hee...
That's the end of my story.
Whose turn is next?{p}

Why are you making that face?
I get it, you don't believe me.
{c}{f:|}, I don't know what you thought of my story, but...
they might be listening.
The people in Sanae's mouth.
They can all read minds.
So if they get angry about what you're feeling right now, {c}{f:|}, they might play some kind of trick on you.
Well, so far, nobody's had anything like that done to them.
Not yet... that is.
Not yet, anyway...
Okay, that's the end of my story.
Whose turn is next...?{p}

What, really★
Then you've seen the rokurokubi too, {c}{f:|}.
That's Sanae.
I didn't know either, but apparently rokurokubi are monsters born from ectoplasm...
But they say only people with a sixth sense can see Sanae's long, stretched-out neck.
That's {c}{f:|} for you.
Aww, so you already knew about Sanae... Then my story must have been boring for you.
Sorry.

What? You didn't actually know★
You just picked an answer★
That's so mean! I wasted an apology on you.
Sanae had loads more secrets, but I'm not telling you any of them now.
Come on, let's hurry on to the next one.{p}
